campaigns.preview.connect_note: A connection request goes without a note: there is nothing to preview.
campaigns.preview.description: A LinkedIn message as the writer would draft it for a sample lead. A preview changes nothing on the campaign; the lead's page lists it among their drafts.
campaigns.preview.failure.ai_failed: the writer's answer failed its checks twice.
campaigns.preview.failure.dossier_lead_n: the lead is no longer in the workspace.
campaigns.preview.failure.draft_requeste: the member who asked for it left the workspace.
campaigns.preview.failure.draft_stuck: the writer took too long and was stopped.
campaigns.preview.failure.other: the writer could not draft this message.
campaigns.preview.failure.profile_not_en: the lead's profile is not in English.
campaigns.preview.failure.write_failed: the writer stopped before it finished.
campaigns.preview.gate.colleague_signal: Points at a colleague of the lead, whose signals stay their own: “{phrase}”
campaigns.preview.gate.facts_used: The plan cites a fact the lead's data does not have.
campaigns.preview.gate.length: {length, number} characters, outside {min, number} to {max, number}.
campaigns.preview.gate.other: A check found a problem in this text.
campaigns.preview.gate.placeholders: A placeholder is left in the text: {placeholder}
campaigns.preview.gate.red_lines: A phrase the red lines forbid: “{phrase}”
campaigns.preview.gate.signal_act: Names what the lead did rather than what the post was about: “{phrase}”
campaigns.preview.no_leads: No lead to preview with yet: import or add leads first.
campaigns.preview.stuck: Still being written after {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, so this page stopped checking. Preview again to ask once more.
campaigns.preview.title: Previews
campaigns.reason.account_paused: LinkedIn warned about the sending account, so Whytide paused it: this step waits until the account is resumed.
campaigns.reason.account_replaced: Another LinkedIn account was connected in place of the sending account, so this sequence ended.
campaigns.reason.account_stopped: The sending account is paused: this step waits until it is resumed.
campaigns.reason.already_connected: This person is already a LinkedIn connection, so this step was not needed.
campaigns.reason.campaign_not_active: Its campaign is paused or not started: this step waits until it runs.
campaigns.reason.content_changed: Its text changed after it was approved, so it was not sent.
campaigns.reason.daily_actions_cap_reach: The sending account's actions for today are used up: this step waits for another day.
campaigns.reason.disclosure_required: The sending account's owner has not accepted the risk disclosure for sending: this step waits until they do.
campaigns.reason.enrollment_paused: The sequence is paused: this step waits until it is resumed.
campaigns.reason.insufficient_credits: Not enough credits: this step waits until the workspace has more.
campaigns.reason.invite_accepted: The connection request was accepted, so this step was not needed.
campaigns.reason.invite_cap_reached: The sending account's connection requests for today are used up: this step waits for another day.
campaigns.reason.invite_note_budget: The sending account's invitations with a note this month are used: this step waits until one frees up.
campaigns.reason.invites_paused: Connection requests are paused, on this Whytide instance or for the sending account: this step waits.
campaigns.reason.linkedin_account_discon: The sending account is disconnected: this step waits until it is connected again.
campaigns.reason.linkedin_error_unmapped: LinkedIn answered in a way Whytide does not know, so it may have been sent: Whytide checks with LinkedIn before anything else goes from the account.
campaigns.reason.linkedin_input_invalid: Whytide could not build a request LinkedIn accepts for this step, so it was not sent and the sequence ended.
campaigns.reason.linkedin_limit_reached: LinkedIn's own limit was reached on the sending account: this step waits for another day.
campaigns.reason.linkedin_not_found: LinkedIn could not find it: the person, or the connection request to withdraw, is gone.
campaigns.reason.linkedin_output_invalid: LinkedIn's answer could not be read, so it may have been sent: Whytide checks with LinkedIn before anything else goes from the account.
campaigns.reason.linkedin_provider_error: LinkedIn failed while sending, so it may have been sent: Whytide checks with LinkedIn before anything else goes from the account.
campaigns.reason.linkedin_rate_limited: LinkedIn asked the sending account to slow down: this step waits.
campaigns.reason.member_id_unknown: Whytide has not checked which LinkedIn account sends this yet: this step waits until it has.
campaigns.reason.member_ref_unknown: Whytide does not know this person's LinkedIn profile yet: this step waits until it does.
campaigns.reason.message_cap_reached: The sending account's messages for today are used up: this step waits for another day.
campaigns.reason.never_contact_company: Their company is on the never-contact list.
campaigns.reason.never_contact_person: They are on the never-contact list.
campaigns.reason.no_linkedin_profile: Whytide knows this person by an email address only, with no LinkedIn profile, so this LinkedIn step was not sent and the sequence ended.
campaigns.reason.no_sender: No connected LinkedIn account to send from: connect one, then approve again.
campaigns.reason.not_accepted: The connection request was not accepted.
campaigns.reason.not_approved: It was not approved, so it was not sent.
campaigns.reason.not_interested: They replied that they are not interested.
campaigns.reason.opted_out: They opted out of being contacted.
campaigns.reason.outside_working_hours: Outside the sending account's working hours: this step waits for the next window.
campaigns.reason.owner_removed: The member whose account sends this campaign was removed from the workspace, so this sequence ended.
campaigns.reason.pending_invites_over_li: The sending account has too many connection requests still pending: this step waits.
campaigns.reason.pending_invites_unknown: Whytide has not counted the sending account's pending connection requests yet: this step waits.
campaigns.reason.platform_stopped: The operator stopped every LinkedIn action on this Whytide instance: this step waits.
campaigns.reason.profile_unreadable: LinkedIn found no profile for this person, so the connection request was not sent and the sequence ended.
campaigns.reason.rate_limited: LinkedIn asked the sending account to slow down: this step waits.
campaigns.reason.read_cap_reached: The sending account's reads for today are used up, and a read comes first (the chat before a message, the profile before a connection request): this step waits for another day.
campaigns.reason.removed: They were removed from the sequence.
campaigns.reason.reservation_not_open: Its place in the sending account's limits was no longer held when it was due: this step waits to be planned again.
campaigns.reason.send_in_flight: Another step to this person is still being sent: this step waits for another day.
campaigns.reason.send_refused: LinkedIn refused to send a step.
campaigns.reason.sender_mismatch: The mailbox chosen for this email now belongs to another member, so the email was not sent.
campaigns.reason.sending_closed: Sending is closed on this Whytide instance until the operator opens it: this step waits.
campaigns.reason.touched_today: They were already contacted today: this step waits for another day.
campaigns.reason.unknown: For a reason this page does not know yet.
campaigns.reason.weekly_invite_cap_reach: The sending account's connection requests for this week are used up: this step waits until the week leaves room.
campaigns.reason.withdrawal_cap_reached: The sending account's withdrawals for today are used up: this step waits for another day.
campaigns.reason.workspace_stopped: Every LinkedIn action in this workspace is stopped: this step waits until the stop is lifted.
campaigns.results.caption: {campaign}: the people at each stage by channel, each share of the stage above
campaigns.results.description: Per campaign: the people enrolled, then on each channel those a step was sent to, who accepted the connection request, who replied and who replied with interest. Each person counts once per stage, and each share is of the stage above. An out-of-office answer or a bounce is no reply.
campaigns.results.empty: No campaign of yours yet. Once one enrolls people, its numbers show here.
campaigns.results.error: The results could not be read.
campaigns.results.title: Results

campaigns.sequence_rule.connect_once: A sequence has one connection request only.
campaigns.sequence_rule.fallback: The fallback emails come last, each sent only while the connection request is not accepted.
campaigns.sequence_rule.first_message: The first LinkedIn message comes right after the connection request, {min, number} to {max, number} hours after it is accepted.
campaigns.sequence_rule.step_action: Each step is a connection request, a LinkedIn message or an email.
campaigns.sequence_rule.step_count: A sequence has 1 to {max, number} steps.
campaigns.sequence_rule.step_delay: Each later step waits {min, number} to {max, number} business days after the step before.
